# Australia Citizenship Quiz

> Independent, non-government site published by Radif Partners: free Australian citizenship test practice (20-question mock tests marked with the real rule, 15 correct answers and all 5 Australian values questions), a residence date calculator for the general residence requirement, and the citizenship fees of form 1298i (July 2026). It is not the Department of Home Affairs and does not take applications.

Site: https://australiacitizenshipquiz.com
Language: Australian English (en-AU)
Contact: contact@australiacitizenshipquiz.com

## Main pages

- [Home: free mock test and the five steps to citizenship](https://australiacitizenshipquiz.com/en/)
- [Method: how questions, dates and fees are checked](https://australiacitizenshipquiz.com/en/method/)
- [About the publisher](https://australiacitizenshipquiz.com/en/about/)

## Data and sources

- Practice questions adapted from Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond, © Commonwealth of Australia 2020, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), rewritten by Radif Partners. They are not the official test questions.
- Test format, residence requirement, ceremonies and processing times: Department of Home Affairs (immi.homeaffairs.gov.au), checked on 25 October 2026.
- Fees: Home Affairs form 1298i, design date July 2026.
